pad-wide-supersaw-chord-pad: clean dense sustain, smooth release decay after note-off; no clicks/aliasing lines; very bright air up to 20 kHz
bass-velocity-hybrid-bass: solid centered fundamental + harmonics in Mid; noise layer swells mostly in Side (peak ~4.5 s); no clicks; reads more 'textural sub' than punchy
swell-multi-envelope-morph-swell: clean, gentle ~1.6 s periodic motion; but energy is present from t=0 so the 'swell' shape is weak visually
gated-fifth-swell-trance-gate: crisp, even 1/8-ish chops, no click lines at gate edges; loop seam invisible
drone-wavetable-artifact-drone: continuous evolving loop, no seam; dense/hissy top (shimmer + artifact layer) worth a taste check
pluck-organic-velocity-pluck: clear note onsets, decaying echo tail; each note's HF ends sharply at the next onset (mono retrigger), audition for tail truncation
